d.ko: A university student named Sae finds herself lost in the mountains.  While searching for help, she comes across an old looking mansion and decides to enter it.  However, there was more to this mansion than meets the eye.  What will become of Sae?  Find out in this Puzzle-Escape RPG!
d.en: A university student named Sae finds herself lost in the mountains.  While searching for help, she comes across an old looking mansion and decides to enter it.  However, there was more to this mansion than meets the eye.  What will become of Sae?  Find out in this Puzzle-Escape RPG!
d.zh: 大学生纱枝在山林间迷了路。在寻求帮助的过程中，她走进了一处看似老旧的宅邸里。然而这座宅邸并不像表面看起来那么简单。纱枝会有怎样的奇遇呢？一切尽在此部逃脱解谜RPG游戏中！
